self.set_size(0.15)
self.go_to_xy(-200, 150)
while True:
    self.glide_to_xy(-40, 150, 2)
    self.glide_to_xy(-200, 150, 2)

self.set_size(0.15)
self.go_to_xy(200, 150)
while True:
    self.glide_to_xy(40, 150, 1.75)
    self.glide_to_xy(200, 150, 1.75)

if self.falling:
    return

self.falling = True

cloud = LeftCloud.the_original()
self.go_to_xy(cloud.x_position, cloud.y_position - 25)

self.show()

while self.y_position > -200:
    self.change_y(-2)

self.falling = False

cloud = RightCloud.the_original()
self.go_to_xy(cloud.x_position, cloud.y_position - 25)

self.show()

while self.y_position > -200:
    self.change_y(-2)

self.delete_this_clone()
